name: Super Skunk
summary: Super Skunk is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] bred by [[breeder:Sensi Seeds]] as an indica-leaning follow-up to [[skunk-1|Skunk #1]], crossing it with an Afghan hash plant to add weight and potency and shorten flowering. Sensi traces its Skunk #1 stock to seeds brought to the Netherlands from the United States in 1982. The breeder says Super Skunk launched in 1990 and won a Cannabis Cup soon after.

sources.title: Super Skunk (regular seeds) product page
sources.note: Sensi says Super Skunk was originally launched in 1990. Described only as a premium Afghan cultivar; the specific Afghan line is not named.

sources.title: 'Skunk Weed': A Beginner's Guide to Skunk
sources.note: Sensi dates its Skunk #1 stock in the Netherlands to 1982, which bounds the start. Bred by Sensi Seeds from Skunk #1 genetics it received in the Netherlands. Described as a potent Afghani hash strain.
